phases.name: null-out early return
phases.note: returns 0 at once; neither the auxiliary callee nor the release callee runs and nothing is written

phases.name: auxiliary call
phases.note: call 0x606ca40 at 0x5d526b8 with (key +0x988, value1, value2, out1, out2) before the tree walk

phases.gate: none; always runs after the auxiliary call
phases.name: tree walk (lower-bound shape)
phases.note: start at the root pointer in key +0xcb0 with the header address key +0xca8 as the not-found sentinel; at each node read left (+0x10), right (+0x18) and the compared field (+0x20); if the field is unsigned-below value1 go to the right child, otherwise record the node as the candidate and go to the left child; a null child ends the walk with the last candidate (or the sentinel when none was recorded); an empty tree (null root) ends the walk at once

phases.gate: candidate is the sentinel, or candidate field >= value2 (unsigned)
phases.name: range failure
phases.note: call 0x60d52f0 with (key +0x988) and return 0; nothing is written through out1 or out2 by the walk

phases.name: range match
phases.note: write the candidate field to *out1, call 0x5d4e140 with (out2, candidate + 0x28), call 0x60d52f0 with (key +0x988), and return 1
